judgments.explanation: The computation-basis bullets visibly use the complete word “excluding”, followed by “capital gain/loss”, with a line break within the phrase where needed. judgments.explanation: The computation-basis bullet visibly prints “1-year”. The corresponding heading reads “Most recent 1-year yield*: XX%”. Separating “1” from “-year” does not change the period. The heading’s asterisk links it to the computation-basis text.
judgments.affected_condition: The most recent 1-year yield uses the stated period from xx Aug 2022 to xx Aug 2023 and excludes capital gain/loss.

judgments.printed_text: #For the most up-to-date daily figure, please refer to [www.xxx.com].
judgments.explanation: The printed “#” is a raised footnote marker immediately before “For”. A matching raised “#” follows “XX%” in the 1-day annualised yield display. Joining the marker to “For” or representing it as a separate token is a typographic difference; both sequences retain the marker and the footnote wording.
judgments.affected_condition: The # footnote attached to the 1-day annualised yield directs readers to [www.xxx.com] for the most up-to-date daily figure.
